products.name: AI Labeling System
products.description:
An internal ML tool built for Sector's XOps platform to automate the classification and validation of penetration testing findings.

The system processes raw HTTP request/response data from security assessments, categorizing each finding into vulnerability types (XSS, SQL Injection, Command Injection, LFI) and determining whether it's a true positive or false positive.

A 3-tier prediction pipeline handles classification: explicit label matching, a Random Forest classifier trained on 100K+ real findings with dual TF-IDF feature extraction, and pattern-based fallback detection. A separate validity detection system analyzes HTTP responses, timing deltas, status codes, and payloads to flag false positives before they reach analysts.

As an internal tool, specifics are limited, but it serves as a quality assurance layer that gives the XOps team confidence in their reporting data across thousands of findings per engagement.
